member.name: F:SysWeaver.SvgOptParams.Compare
member.summary: Supply a filename to create a .html file that can be used to compare the original and the modified files. ".html" is appended unless the name ends with ".htm" or ".html", a name without a folder is created in the output folder. No file is created if no files were processed.

member.name: M:SysWeaver.SvgOptProgram.Main(System.String[])
member.summary: Process exit codes (from SysWeaver.CommandLine FilesToFolderTool), 0 = success, non-zero (1-255) = failure: 0 = success or help requested, 1 = an exception while processing, 2 = invalid command line. A file that fails to optimize is only reported, it doesn't change the exit code.
